description: MainViewModel.kt defines the MainViewModel class which manages the app's core UI state, interacts with runtime components, device permissions, and handles user interaction logic within the Android application. It integrates with various app modules like chat, camera, gateway, voice, and preferences, providing a centralized ViewModel for UI data binding and state management.

classes.name: MainViewModel
classes.description: The MainViewModel class is an Android ViewModel managing the application's UI-related data and interactions. It interfaces with runtime components, preferences, and UI states, providing observable flows for various app states and user actions.

methods.name: attachRuntimeUi
methods.description: Attaches camera lifecycle and permission request handlers to the runtime components for UI integration.

methods.name: setForeground
methods.description: Sets whether the app should run in the foreground and updates runtime foreground state accordingly.

methods.name: setDisplayName
methods.description: Updates the display name preference.

methods.name: setCameraEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables the device camera via preferences.

methods.name: setLocationMode
methods.description: Sets the location mode setting.

methods.name: setLocationPreciseEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables precise location.

methods.name: setPreventSleep
methods.description: Prevents device sleep according to user preference.

methods.name: setManualEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables manual configuration.

methods.name: setManualHost
methods.description: Sets the manual host address.

methods.name: setManualPort
methods.description: Sets the manual port number.

methods.name: setManualTls
methods.description: Enables or disables TLS for manual connection.

methods.name: setGatewayToken
methods.description: Stores the gateway token.

methods.name: setGatewayBootstrapToken
methods.description: Stores the gateway bootstrap token.

methods.name: setOnboardingCompleted
methods.description: Marks onboarding as complete and initializes runtime if necessary.

methods.name: setCanvasDebugStatusEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables canvas debug status.

methods.name: setNotificationForwardingEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables notification forwarding in the runtime.

methods.name: setNotificationForwardingMode
methods.description: Sets the notification forwarding mode.

methods.name: setNotificationForwardingPackagesCsv
methods.description: Sets notification forwarding packages from CSV input.

methods.name: setNotificationForwardingQuietHours
methods.description: Configures quiet hours for notification forwarding.

methods.name: setNotificationForwardingMaxEventsPerMinute
methods.description: Sets maximum notification events per minute.

methods.name: setNotificationForwardingSessionKey
methods.description: Sets the notification forwarding session key.

methods.name: handleAssistantLaunch
methods.description: Handles launch requests from the assistant and updates chat draft or auto-send state.

methods.name: clearChatDraft
methods.description: Clears the chat message draft.

methods.name: refreshChatSessions
methods.description: Refreshes chat sessions, optionally limited by count.

methods.name: switchChatSession
methods.description: Switches active chat session by key.

methods.name: abortChat
methods.description: Aborts the current chat process.
